name: dropdown-04
title: Grouped menu
description: Actions in groups split by hairlines, delete last on its own.

files.content:
import {
  BoltIcon,
  ChevronDownIcon,
  CopyPlusIcon,
  FilesIcon,
  Layers2Icon,
  TrashIcon,
} from '@/registry/ndeko/lib/icons';
import { Button } from '@/registry/ndeko/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/registry/ndeko/ui/dropdown-menu';

export default function Dropdown04() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant='outline' />}>
        Frame options
        <ChevronDownIcon className='-me-1 opacity-60' />
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <CopyPlusIcon />
            Copy
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <BoltIcon />
            Edit
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Layers2Icon />
            Group
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <FilesIcon />
            Clone
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem variant='destructive'>
          <TrashIcon />
          Delete
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
